message.content:
## Changelog (DOC-SKILL-008)

- Integrated a bounded fixed-model mini documentation-skill path for seven approved mini skills.
- Operator prompt offers 1 = Codex and 2 = OpenRouter for eligible mini documentation tasks.
- Runner reports actual OR cost after completion when telemetry is accepted.
- A seven-skill live batch completed with validation_result=PASS for all accepted rows.
- The 5.4 candidate phase remains planning-only; starts with fixture preparation.
- **Caveats:** No production routing enabled. No canonical routing-table update made. Auto Router remains experiment-only. The 5.4 phase has not yet run live OR evaluations.
